source: Blender Studio 'storm' rig v1.1 (CC-BY 4.0): ribbon weights and face control shapes
weights_doc: lips_*: u 0=center 1=corner, roles C/1/2/K(corner). lids_*: u 0=inner 1=outer corner, roles in/a/mid/b/out
shapes_doc: rot: shape axes in world space (storm faces -Y); size: scale xyz * bone length / eye_dist; offset: from the display (DSP) bone head / eye_dist; offset_bone: from the control's own head / eye_dist
extras_doc: eyesocket: u along the lid line, s = radial scale from the lid centroid (front plane), then snapped to the skin. blink: PRP offset / length / travel in eye_dist.
